Install Packages
```{r}
library(rlang) #download/install Rtools4 package according to your R version IF there are issues with rlang https://mirror.las.iastate.edu/CRAN/
library(testthat)
library(ecorest)
```



EcoRest Testing Plan

*HSIarimean*
```{r}
#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIarimean(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5)),0.5) 

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIarimean(c(0.5,0.5,0.5)),0.5)  

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIarimean(c(-50,50)),0)

#error case
testthat::expect_error(HSIarimean(c()))

```

*HSIwarimean*
```{r}
#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIwarimean(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),c(0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25)),0.5) 

#error case
testthat::expect_error(HSIwarimean(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5))) 

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIwarimean(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,1),c(NA,NA,NA,1)),1) 

#error case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIwarimean(c(-1),c(1)),"Habitat suitability index not within 0 to 1 range.")

#error case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIwarimean(c(2),c(1)),"Habitat suitability index not within 0 to 1 range.")

#error case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIwarimean(c(1),c(-1)),"Weights do not equal 1.")

```

*HSIeqtn*
```{r}
#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIeqtn("barredowl",c(1,1,1), HSImetadata),1) 

#error case

#error case
testthat::expect_error(HSIeqtn("nonexistent_model", c(0,NA,1), HSImetadata))

#error case
testthat::expect_equal(HSIeqtn("barredowl", c(1,1,1,1), HSImetadata),"SIV vector length does not match equation.")

#error case
testthat::expect_error(HSIeqtn("barredowl", c(), HSImetadata))

#error case
testthat::expect_error(HSIeqtn("barredowl", c(0,NA,1)))

```

*SIcalc*
```{r}
var1 <- cbind(c(0,2,4,NA), c(0.1,1,1,NA)) #Number of trees > 51cm diameter per 0.4 ha plot
var2 <- cbind(c(0,5,20,NA), c(0,0,1,NA)) #Mean diameter of overstory trees
var3 <- cbind(c(0,20,60,100), c(0,0,1,1)) #Percent canopy cover of overstory trees
barredowl <- cbind(var1, var2, var3)
colnames(barredowl)<- c("tree.num", "tree.num.SIV",
  "avg.dbh.in", "avg.dbh.SIV", "can.cov", "can.cov.SIV")

#pass case
input.demo1 <- c(2, 5, 20)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo1),c(1,0,0))

#pass case
input.demo2 <- c(NA, 5, 20)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo2),c(NA,0,0))

#pass case
input.demo3 <- c(NA, NA, NA)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo3),c(NA,NA,NA))

#error case
input.demo4 <- c(1)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo4),"Number of inputs does not equal number of SI values.")

#error case
input.demo5 <- c(1,1,1,1)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo5),"Number of inputs does not equal number of SI values.")

#pass case
input.demo6 <- c(-1,-1,-1)
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo6),c(0.1,0,0))

#error case
input.demo7 <- c()
testthat::expect_equal(SIcalc(barredowl, input.demo7),"Number of inputs does not equal number of SI values.")

#error case
input.demo8 <- c(2, 5, 20)
testthat::expect_error(SIcalc(nonexistent_model, input.demo8))

#error case
input.demo9 <- c(c(1,1,1),1,1)
testthat::expect_error(SIcalc(nonexistent_model, input.demo9))

```

*HUCalc*
```{r}

input.demo1 <- c(0.1,1)
result1 <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, nrow = 1, ncol = 3))
colnames(result1) = c("Quality", "Quantity", "IndexUnits")
result1[1,1] = 0.55
result1[1,2] = 100
result1[1,3] = 55

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,100,HSIarimean)[1,1],result1[1,1])
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,100,HSIarimean)[1,2],result1[1,2])
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,100,HSIarimean)[1,3],result1[1,3])

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,0,HSIarimean)[1,1],0.55)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,0,HSIarimean)[1,2],0)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,0,HSIarimean)[1,3],0)

#pass case
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,-100,HSIarimean)[1,1],0.55)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,-100,HSIarimean)[1,2],-100)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo1,-100,HSIarimean)[1,3],-55)

#pass case
input.demo2 <- c(0)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo2,100,HSIarimean)[1,1],0)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo2,100,HSIarimean)[1,2],100)
testthat::expect_equal(HUcalc(input.demo2,100,HSIarimean)[1,3],0)

#error case
input.demo3 <- c()
testthat::expect_error(HUcalc(input.demo3,100,HSIarimean)[1,1])
testthat::expect_error(HUcalc(input.demo3,100,HSIarimean)[1,2])
testthat::expect_error(HUcalc(input.demo3,100,HSIarimean)[1,3])
```

*CEfinder*
```{r}

#pass case
benefit <- c(0,10,5,20,20)
cost <- c(0,100,100,200,150)
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(1,1,0,0,1))

#pass case
benefit <- c(-10,10,5,20,20)
cost <- c(0,100,100,200,150)
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(1,1,0,0,1))

#pass case
benefit <- c(0,10,5,20,20)
cost <- c(-10,100,100,200,150)
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(1,1,0,0,1))

#pass case
benefit <- c(0,0,0,0,0)
cost <- c(0,100,100,200,150)
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(1,0,0,0,0))

#pass case
benefit <- c()
cost <- c(0,100,100,200,150)
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(0))

#pass case
benefit <- c()
cost <- c()
testthat::expect_equal(CEfinder(benefit,cost),c(0))
```

*BBfinder*
Testing done on separate application. Successfully passes. 

*CEICAplotter*

```{r}
altnames <- c("No Action","Plan 1","Plan 2","Plan 3","Plan 4")
benefit <- c(0,41.63,49.5,83.75,84)
cost <- c(0,19.7,29.7,260.2,313.8)
CE <- CEfinder(benefit,cost)
BB <- BBfinder(benefit,cost,CE)[[1]][,4]
outfile_CEICA <- tempfile(fileext='.jpeg') #create temporary file to copy to
CEICAplotter(altnames,benefit,cost,CE,BB,outfile_CEICA)
#knitr::include_graphics("ZZ_Fig02.01_NYBEM.Extent.jpeg")
```
